status: locked shared pipeline contract; hero-specific dimensions/anatomy remain marked proposal in roster

axes.rule: glTF exporter performs coordinate conversion once. Do not add a second corrective root rotation. In Godot orient model front with use_model_front=true.

origin.meaning: center of supporting sole footprint; serpent coil contact centroid

height.measurement: floor to skull top in neutral production pose; exclude ears, horns, antlers, hair crest and raised wings
height.weapon_and_extension_bounds: record separately to prevent camera clipping

rest_pose: T-pose biped; versioned grounded S-tail for serpentine; jaw neutral, fingers relaxed open

root_motion.presentation_offsets: Move wrapper visual pivot only from combat timeline; reset after action. Pelvis may breathe/recoil locally. Never drive resolver position or damage.

weapon_attachment.method: BoneAttachment3D on socket bone, or documented bone-local transform from socket metadata; no guessed world offsets
weapon_attachment.socket_axes: inherit documented bone-local rest axes; separate hand-specific attachment transform
weapon_attachment.dominant_hand: unresolved per hero until reference packet; mirrored visuals cannot reverse semantic entity IDs

materials.orm: R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic; scalar channels linear
materials.texture_dimensions: power of two; choose actual sizes by measured phone result, no invented final budget
materials.alpha: opaque or deliberate mask; blended fur cards require measured justification
materials.export: GLB embeds validated textures; no external arbitrary source paths, cameras or lights

wrapper.simulation_interface: Consumes entity ID, event ID, semantic state and event time. Cannot mutate combat stats or apply damage.
